name: notebooklm as a micro enterprise
says: i wanna stand up a NotebookLM https://github.com/teng-lin/notebooklm-py app inside our enterprise's digital platform, as a micro-enterprise itself, so taht other micro-enterprises can contract it, send it packets of resources, and be like, gimme a pdf, gimme an infographic, gimme a report and here's the prompt, but also, these days, notebooklm can produce flashcards, json mind maps, csv data reports. We could offload a LOT of data distillation/analysis to it, and that'd be a great cost savings!
